copy.heading: Terms of engagement
body: This engagement covers conversation only. It is not padel coaching and has no view on your vibora. Keep playing padel if padel makes you happy. The engagement simply asks that you also talk about other things, now and then, to the people who have to listen.
Any resemblance to a padel player you know is entirely intentional in spirit and entirely accidental in every way a solicitor would care about.
No padel club, brand, player or governing body has approved this engagement. Several would prefer you carried on exactly as you are.
